title: Add Owner, Owned, Edge, and Connection to Every Entity
description: Add union XOwner, union XOwned, type XEdge implements EntityEdge, and type XConnection implements EntityConnection for every entity type in semio/graphql/target.schema.graphql. Also make Side implement Entity, make Diffs an interface, add missing PieceModification type, fix the EntityConnection union/interface conflict, and update owner/owns fields to use typed versions.
